origin.additional_discovery_2026_07_30: Confirmed at runtime while proving MT-019 P-1: the same sandbox_adapter_id omission that made the new P-1 regression test unfalsifiable also breaks one pre-existing stale-source test and renders another vacuous. This is the third instance in one session of a test being silently red or vacuous because the declared proofs only ever ran narrow --exact filters (the first was five tests in the production_factory lib module).

scope.summary: Repair five PRE-EXISTING failing tests in the production_factory lib module that are invisible to MT-017's declared proof set, so the module is honestly green rather than green-by-narrow-filter.
scope.root_cause: MT-017 proof command [16] runs ONLY swarm_orchestration::production_factory::tests::factory_dispatches_official_cli_to_cli_builder, which passes. Running the WHOLE module (2026-07-30, both parallel and serial: 27 passed / 5 failed, EXIT=101) exposes five failures that the narrow filter hides. TWO DISTINCT CAUSES. (a) FOUR tests fail with PROCESS_LEDGER_DURABILITY_ACK_TIMEOUT ('START row for process_uuid ... was not durably acknowledged within 5000 ms'): byok_cloud_provider_selection_honors_anthropic_when_openai_also_configured (production_factory.rs:2712), official_cli_provider_selection_honors_requested_provider (:2812), cloud_success_dispatch_records_start_and_teardown_records_stop_and_unloads (:2631), from_vault_factory_cloud_spawn_records_start_and_stop (:3210). All four build their ledger with ledger_pair() (production_factory.rs:2263-2272), which calls LedgerBatcher::manual_for_tests - a MANUAL batcher that spawns no writer task and therefore can never durably acknowledge a START row, while record_cloud_session_start awaits exactly that ack. The passing sibling factory_dispatches_official_cli_to_cli_builder instead uses an explicit LedgerBatcher::spawn plus drain_and_join_ledger_writer, which is why it is unaffected. (b) ONE test, production_coordinator_constructs_and_rejects_unloadable_local_spawn_without_orphan (:2423), asserts matches!(err, SwarmError::FactoryFailed(_)) for a missing-artifact local spawn but receives SwarmError::LedgerFailed from the ModelLaneStore dexterity guard at coordinator.rs:992 ('ModelLaneStore-backed coordinators require SpawnRequest::with_dexterity_launch before runtime creation'), because the coordinator is built with lazy_model_lane_store() (:2274-2279). The guard fires before the factory is ever reached, so the expectation is stale.
forbidden_paths: deleting, #[ignore]-ing, or narrowing any failing test to make the module green
weakening or removing the durability-ack requirement in record_cloud_session_start
weakening the ModelLaneStore dexterity-launch guard at coordinator.rs:992
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The four DURABILITY_ACK_TIMEOUT tests pass because the ledger is actually driven (drive/drain the manual batcher, or build these tests on a spawned LedgerBatcher like factory_dispatches_official_cli_to_cli_builder does). The durability-ack requirement in record_cloud_session_start MUST NOT be relaxed, shortened, or made conditional to achieve this.

AC-2: production_coordinator_constructs_and_rejects_unloadable_local_spawn_without_orphan is corrected to assert the behaviour the product actually guarantees. DECIDE explicitly and record the rationale: either the test should not use a ModelLaneStore-backed coordinator for a missing-artifact case, or the guard legitimately precedes factory dispatch and the expectation must change. Do NOT weaken the guard.
AC-3: The full module runs green with NO name filter: cargo test --lib swarm_orchestration::production_factory::tests (both default-parallel and --test-threads=1). Report both.
AC-4: No test is deleted, ignored, or renamed to dodge the failure; the count of executed tests does not decrease.

AC-5: Confirm and record whether these five failures also reproduce at commit 6fd044b0^ (i.e. before the MT-017 fixes). The MT-017 analysis concluded PRE-EXISTING on mechanism grounds - the ack requirement and ledger_pair() helper are untouched by that commit, and the BYOK path is byte-identical - but an A/B baseline was never run. Establish it here.

AC-6 [ADDED 2026-07-30, runtime-confirmed]: repair the two pre-existing stale-source test defects in tests/process_ledger_reclaim_tests.rs, both caused by rows that never set sandbox_adapter_id while stale_sessions has always required sandbox_adapter_id IS NOT NULL. (a) postgres_stale_source_selects_terminal_lane_exact_process_owner FAILS (observed: 2 passed; 1 failed; finished in 2792.03s) because its session can never be selected. (b) postgres_stale_source_does_not_cross_reclaim_healthy_sibling_lane PASSES VACUOUSLY: its rows are equally ineligible, so its negative assertion !stale_sessions.contains(session_id) is unfalsifiable and would keep passing even if cross-reclaim protection were deleted entirely. Fix both by seeding sandbox_adapter_id so the rows are genuinely eligible, then confirm (a) passes for a real reason and (b) still passes while being falsifiable - prove (b) by temporarily making the sibling reclaimable and observing the assertion FAIL.
scope.risk_if_missed: The production_factory module carries five silent failures. Any future WP that widens the proof filter beyond the single declared test inherits a red module and cannot tell new breakage from old. Worse, the four ack timeouts mean the cloud-session START durability path has NO honest passing coverage in this module, so a real durability regression would be indistinguishable from the known noise. Additionally, the cross-reclaim protection for stale sessions currently has NO falsifiable test: postgres_stale_source_does_not_cross_reclaim_healthy_sibling_lane would pass even if that protection were removed, so a regression there would ship silently.

implementation_notes: Do not 'fix' this by shortening the 5000 ms ack deadline or making the ack optional - that would delete the durability guarantee these tests exist to prove.

ledger_pair() at production_factory.rs:2263 is shared by several tests; changing it affects every caller. Prefer giving the four cloud tests a driven ledger over mutating the shared manual helper, unless a repo-wide audit shows every caller wants a driven batcher.
Reference the working pattern in factory_dispatches_official_cli_to_cli_builder (LedgerBatcher::spawn + drain_and_join_ledger_writer, ~production_factory.rs:3530-3592).

AC-5 baseline: `git stash` and `git checkout --` are gated destructive operations under AGENTS.md and Codex CX-108 and require same-turn Operator authorization. A non-destructive alternative is `git archive 6fd044b0^ | tar -x -C <tmp>` into a scratch dir with its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
